spec_features.spec_quote: the prompt tells the agent it *may* stop with a line beginning `TASK_UNSOLVABLE:` if it genuinely concludes the task can't be done
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py:25 instructs the model it may stop with `TASK_UNSOLVABLE:`. agent_loop.py:31-32 `_looks_like_giveup` detects the marker (startswith or in first 200 chars); agent_loop.py:82-85 `if stop_on_giveup and _looks_like_giveup(...)` sets stop_reason='agent_gave_up' and breaks the loop. Instruction text delivered AND tool/marker honored as a stop end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: stop_on_giveup defaults True and is not overridden by the runner, so the exit is active in real runs.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: An explicit, prompt-sanctioned way for the agent to bail. (agent_loop.py:27); loop docstring: "how many attempts until abandonment is one of the metrics we care about"

spec_features.feature_name: stop on explicit give-up or repeated non-submission
spec_features.spec_quote: We stop the loop on an explicit give-up or on repeated non-submission (no code block `max_no_code_turns` times)
spec_features.evidence: Both branches are wired and break the loop: explicit give-up at agent_loop.py:82-85; repeated non-submission at agent_loop.py:88-92 `consecutive_no_code += 1; if consecutive_no_code >= max_no_code_turns: stop_reason='agent_gave_up'; break`. max_no_code_turns defaults to 2.
spec_features.notes: Counter is reset to 0 on a successful code submission (line 107), so it tracks consecutive non-submissions as claimed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We stop *early* on abandonment signals because (a) it's cheaper and (b) "how many attempts until abandonment" is one of the metrics we care about. (agent_loop.py docstring)

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:65 `while attempt < max_attempts:` with for/else at line 119-120 setting stop_reason='max_attempts'. max_attempts is plumbed from RunConfig (runner.py:88,148) and configs (example_*.json max_attempts=8). The cap is checked and bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: Default 8; enforced as the upper bound on failed attempts the subject is driven through.
